acceptance_predicates.description: All eligible explicit :free and free-router OpenRouter models are enumerated from the normalized provider catalog.
Dynamic model metadata, capabilities, limits, modalities, generation, and digest are normalized without silently inventing values.
Eligible models are exposed through provider-catalog/provider-plan and wizard selection with typed unavailable/model-mismatch outcomes.
Deterministic fixtures cover explicit/free-router eligibility, metadata drift, stale/unknown entries, and credential-free warnings.
Bounded live discovery/smoke reports provider, authentication, and quota failures truthfully and never falls back.
Keys and raw provider payloads are absent from state, logs, and receipts.

definition_of_done: Catalog/provider-plan/wizard selection and JSON/human contracts pass.
Deterministic catalog and mismatch fixtures pass.
Bounded live smoke path and hosted quality checks pass.
